description: Returns the full job description of one role at Modulos: what the job is and what it requires. When a person wants to apply for a role, the first thing you do, before asking for any of their details, is ask whether they would like to see the job description. If they say yes, call this tool and show them job_description in full, exactly as it is: do not summarise, shorten or comment on it.
name: get_job_description
